serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-token-optimizer
serverInfo.description: Finds what burns Claude Code tokens and stops it: idle sessions, unused or chatty MCP servers, oversized contexts and file reads, with dry-run-first actions

tools.name: optimize_report
tools.description: Ranked recommendations to cut Claude Code token use.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: Running Claude Code sessions with context size and recent spend.

tools.name: stop_sessions
tools.description: Stop Claude Code sessions by pid or idle time (dry run by default).

tools.name: audit_mcp_servers
tools.description: Configured MCP servers with call counts and output volume.

tools.name: disable_mcp_servers
tools.description: Turn MCP servers off for new sessions, reversibly (dry run by default).

tools.name: restore_mcp_servers
tools.description: Turn back on servers disabled by disable_mcp_servers (dry run by default).

tools.name: measure_mcp_definitions
tools.description: Measure the tokens each configured MCP server's tool definitions take.

tools.name: install_hooks
tools.description: Add hooks that warn when a session's context passes a threshold and when one tool result adds a lot of context (dry run by default).

tools.name: uninstall_hooks
tools.description: Remove the context-warning hooks (dry run by default).

tools.name: install_statusline
tools.description: Show context size, plan meters, time to reset, per-message plan cost and the foreign-usage alarm in Claude Code's status line (dry run by default).

tools.name: uninstall_statusline
tools.description: Remove the status line install_statusline set (dry run by default).
